title: O Land of the Gods (Ko Ri Ki Blei)
cultural_context: Published historical Khasi song from authentic literature, documenting ancestral culture, moral philosophy, and oral tradition.
lyrics_khasi:
Ko Ri ba itynnad, ko Ri jong ki lum,
Ka Ri ba la bsa da ki wah ba sngur;
Ki tymmen ki la thoh ia ka nam jong pha,
Kum ka Ri kaba dap da ka jingsuk bad ka hok.

Ha ki pynthor bad ki khlaw kyntang,
Ngi iohi ia ka jingthaw ba kordor;
To ngin iada ia pha da ka mynsiem ba rhem,
Ba ka nam jong pha kan iai phyrnai.
lyrics_english:
O beautiful homeland, land of majestic peaks,
Motherland nourished by crystalline cascading waters;
Our ancestors engraved thy glorious renown,
As a land replete with peace and justice.

Across the terraced vales and sacred groves,
We behold the handiwork of divine creation;
Let us protect thee with fervent devotion,
That thy honor may shine forever untarnished.
